description: This file defines the SystemMenuOffCanvasForm class, a Drupal form handler for editing system menus with off-canvas UI, including form building, validation, submission, and plugin management.

classes.name: SystemMenuOffCanvasForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for managing off-canvas menu settings within the system module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for menu storage, entity management, translation, and configuration.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for editing menus, including form elements and layout adjustments.

methods.name: validateConfigurationForm
methods.description: Validates the form input, delegating to plugin and entity form validation.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, saving menu configurations.

methods.name: getEntityForm
methods.description: Retrieves the entity form object for a given menu.

methods.name: setPlugin
methods.description: Sets the plugin and loads the associated menu override.

methods.name: hasMenuOverrides
methods.description: Checks if the menu has configuration overrides.
